@@U00094@@
You must, you must!
Even if it costs me my life!
(He seizes the book and soundlessly pronounces the symbol of the
Earth Spirit. The EARTH SPIRIT appears in a flash of red flame.)

@@U00096@@
Who calls me?

@@U00098@@
(With face averted.)

@@U00099@@
Appalling vision!

@@U00101@@
You have used mighty means to draw me,
and have long sucked at my sphere,
and now—

@@U00103@@
Ah! No! I can’t bear to see you!

@@U00105@@
You pleaded breathlessly to see me,
to see my face, hear my voice.
I yield now to your soul’s mighty urging,
and here I am!
But look at you now,
you would-be superman!
Cowering like some pitiable creature!
Where is your soul’s call now?
Your promptings?
Your urgings?
Where is the heart that expanded to hold a world
of its own making in itself;
that sustained and cherished it;
that trembled with rapture
at the thought of equaling the spirit world?
Where are you, 浮士德,
whose voice rang out to me with such passionate urgency?
translation:
@@U00094@@
你必须，你必须！
哪怕要我的命！
（他抓起书本，无声地念出这个符号
大地之灵。大地之灵出现在红色火焰的闪光中。）

@@U00096@@
谁打电话给我？

@@U00098@@
（脸别开。）

@@U00099@@
令人震惊的视力！

@@U00101@@
你用了强大的手段来吸引我，
并长期吸食我的球体，
现在——

@@U00103@@
啊！不！我不忍心见到你！

@@U00105@@
你气喘吁吁地恳求见我，
看到我的脸，听到我的声音。
我现在屈服于你灵魂的强烈催促，
我在这里！
但看看现在的你，
你想成为超人！
像某种可怜的生物一样畏缩着！
你灵魂的呼唤现在在哪里？
你的提示？
你的催促？
扩张容纳世界的心在哪里
是它自己造成的；
维持并珍惜它；
欣喜若狂地颤抖
想到与灵界平起平坐吗？
浮士德你在哪里
是谁的声音如此急切地向我响起？
